messages.content: Build a chess engine in 4 KB Python for the make.fun tiny-chess-01 bounty.
Starting fresh with a negamax alpha-beta search engine. Reading the kit starter first.

Wrote engine.py v0: board representation, pseudo/legality movegen, eval via material + PSTs. Depth-4 negamax. First compression: 4.2 KB — too big. Need to shrink.

Second round: inlined eval into a single loop, merged attacker detection into fewer branches, replaced verbose strings with shorter names. Down to 3.5 KB. Good.
Added killer-move heuristic and transposition table (keyed by tuple(board)) to speed up repeated positions. Added depth-5 search with quiescence at depth 4 for tactical stability.

Compressed with node cli/makefun.mjs compress engine.py --out main.py. Output: 3515 bytes. Passed size cap. Committed to GitHub repo breezesamuel/tiny-chess-4k-engine, pushed 3 commits, bundled transcripts, submitted entry 01a1e7c4.
